recentItems.title: Albin Myers X ILY - FREE (LOVECORE)
recentItems.description:
https://Axtone.lnk.to/FREE

With two decades in the game, platinum-selling Swedish DJ & producer Albin Myers has cemented his place in the global dance scene – moving fluidly between underground credibility and main-stage impact.

Best known for acclaimed originals like “Hells Bells” and high-profile remixes for Avicii and Axwell /\ Ingrosso, Albin has also collaborated with Steve Aoki, opened for The Prodigy, and consistently earned support from tastemakers across radio and club culture. Both his projects MATK and Rave Commission have been playlisted and played on Swedish national radio P3, with MATK even landing daily rotation. Pedro Winter (Busy P) has also supported MATK on his Apple Music radio show.

Alongside his solo output, Albin has released on Axtone and Magician’s Potion Records as part of Mohawk and the Kid, delivering French house and classic house-inspired material, including their album on Magician’s label in 2022. He’s also collaborated across scenes, including a remix for Swedish indie band JUNG with Norwegian pop artist Dagny, and has shared stages with artists such as Braxe & DJ Falcon at ADE.

Under his Rave Commission alias, Albin taps into the energy and aesthetics of classic ’90s rave culture, with his remix of DOD’s breakout hit standing as the most widely recognised release from that project. The rest of the output leans deliberately underground, built for sweaty rooms and late-night dancefloors.

Now returning to Axtone with “FREE (LOVECORE)” alongside singer ILY, Albin continues to balance forward-thinking club music with a deep respect for dance music heritage. A relentless creative force, he divides his time between the studio and the road, with no signs of slowing down.

https://axtone.lnk.to/FirebeatzInSpace

recentItems.title: Firebeatz - In Space (Extended Mix)
recentItems.description:
Dutch duo Firebeatz make their debut on Axtone with a much-coveted ID, marking a clear statement of intent from both the artists and the label as to what they have in store for 2026.

“In Space” became the subject of widespread online chatter after Axwell dropped it on the Tomorrowland Mainstage, where the burnt-out production created a dystopian backdrop and the track proved the perfect soundtrack. Since then, “In Space” has become a mainstay in Axwell’s sets, with Swedish House Mafia also playing it during their New Year’s Eve show at Pier 80 Warehouse in San Francisco, USA.

ANDY C ft Axwell & Max'C - Believe Again (I Found U) -  Extended Mix
Axwell ft. Steve Edwards "Watch The Sunrise" (TEDDY-O Radio Edit)
recentItems.description:
https://axtone.lnk.to/WatchTheSunriseTEDDY-ORemix

Debuted by Axwell at the Axtone party during this year’s Miami Music Week, TEDDY-O’s remix of the 2005 classic Watch The Sunrise by Axwell featuring Steve Edwards has been in high demand across clubs and online platforms ever since.

TEDDY-O is internationally renowned for remixes that fuse hip-hop and Afro house, rising to global attention with his viral remix of Travis Scott’s FE!N, which became a worldwide club anthem. In 2025, he won the EDM Award in Miami for Best Afro House Remix with YO VOY featuring Daddy Yankee and Zion. His collaboration with HUGEL, Champs In The Rave was released on Make The Girls Dance Records.

A regular fixture at events from Mykonos to Miami, London to Ibiza, TEDDY-O’s productions have earned support from Keinemusik, Diplo, Hugel, MoBlack, Francis Mercier, Loco Dice, Fideles, Alex Wann, Blond:ish, Rivo, Bedouin and more.
